heading.title: Appearance of parties and consequence of non-appearance

article.title: Where neither party appears suit to be dismissed.
article.content:
3Where neither party appears suit to be dismissed.

Order 9, Rule 3
Where neither party appears when the suit is called on for hearing, the court may make an order that the suit be dismissed.
